Klimontow clerk uses "z ...ow" for both surnames and patronymics, so the construction
settles nothing by itself; what settles it is the word inside. On the very page facing
this act he writes "z KIMLOW" (act 18/1852), and elsewhere "z MELECHOW" (26/1854) -
Kimel and Melech being given names, exactly like Lewek - alongside true surnames like
"z Grynbergow".
